This plot is very small, just a tiny piece near the house, and beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does — my mother always said beans feed the soil themselves. I have some cattle manure from our compound that I will spread before planting, that is what most of my neighbors do on their bean plots too. I cannot afford to buy DAP for such a small plot, one bag would be too much and cost too much cash I do not have. I will use the bean seeds I saved from last season's harvest, and my husband and I will manage the weeding ourselves without hiring anyone.
